description: tether/render.py formats tether/status.py check results into human-facing markdown; its per-state branches (HEALTHY collapse, DRIFTED diff blocks, BROKEN rename-candidate lines, the normalization_rescued note) track status.py's state model and ArtifactCheck shape. A new aggregate/artifact state or a new ArtifactCheck field needs matching presentation in render.py, or it is silently omitted from the status/show/refs markdown output.
